meta.title: Retailer size charts and population body measurements
meta.purpose: Fit clothing by real body measurements against each retailer's own published size chart, and give characters measurements from national anthropometric surveys, in place of choosing a size from a BMI share.
meta.units: cm unless stated; ranges are [min,max]; a single number is a point; fields ending In are inches as published, and an entry whose note says 'converted' has cm computed at 2.54
meta.confirmedMeaning: true = read from the retailer's or agency's own page, file or data endpoint (H&M from its own 2023 pages via the Wayback Machine, dated in 'archived'); false = search-engine summary or third-party copy

NHANES 2017-March 2020 and 2021-2023 hip circumference microdata (BMXHIP in the BMX_P / BMX_L files) to compute civilian hip percentiles by sex and age.
Statistics Canada primary tables, e.g. https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/n1/pub/82-626-x/2013001/t018-eng.htm (CHMS 2009-2011 waist by age and sex), to cross-check the NASEM-tabulated CHMS figures.
HSE 2024 Table 3 (mean BMI by age and sex) in the same xlsx; and HSE 2022 overweight tables https://files.digital.nhs.uk/B2/7AACB5/HSE-2022-Overweight-and-obesity-tables.xlsx.
ENSANUT 2018-19 microdata (CN_ANTROPOMETRIA, INEGI) to compute mean and percentile height, weight and waist by sex and age.
ANSUR II public CSV (https://www.openlab.psu.edu/ansur2/) for bust-related dimensions (chest circumference below breast, bustpoint breadth) and age splits.
Irish Universities Nutrition Alliance National Adult Nutrition Survey (NANS 2008-2010): measured height, weight, waist and hip by sex and age.
Primark/Penneys, J.Crew, lululemon, Aritzia, Simons, Joe Fresh, Everlane and El Palacio de Hierro figures are confirmed:false and need a real browser read before they are used as fact.
adidas Mexico's MX shoe size is not centimetres (MX = UK - 1.5); Flexi and Andrea MX sizes are centimetres, and Andrea's size is foot length plus 7 mm.
Nike's cm/JP shoe column may be the box size rather than bare foot length; Uniqlo's footCm is its JP size, insole about 1.3 cm longer.
ANSUR II (US Army 2012) is a fitness-screened military sample and the only chest/hip reference found; NHANES BMXHIP microdata (2017-2020, 2021-2023) would give a civilian hip reference.
